rationale: The reconstruction correctly identifies that the two local predicates expand to the same plus-sign scalar transport residual, so the selected source implies this formal fragment. But the translation collapses the two fields and coefficients into one predicate instance, restricts the shared speed to the right-going regime, and omits the explicitly retained physical distinction and methodological consequence. Therefore the reverse implication fails, the translation is not-faithful-weaker, and the evidence is determinate without adjudication.
